arguments.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for the meeting. Here’s a quick summary of decisions and next steps:
- Phase‑two rollout will start on 2026‑02‑10.
- Weekly status calls are now scheduled for Tuesdays at 10:00.
- The reporting dashboard will use the revised metric definitions.

Action items:
- Dana will circulate the revised rollout timeline by 2026‑01‑09.
- Priya will confirm the dashboard metric definitions with the data team.
- All parties will prepare the phase‑two risk register before the next status call.

Best regards,
Dana Whitfield
